title: SnapLog Screenshot Metadata
description: Canonical schema for screenshot metadata produced by both Windows (Electron/Playwright) and Android capture engines. Every evidence artifact must conform to this contract before being stored in forensic.db or passed to the report pipeline.

examiner_id.description: ID of the forensic examiner / officer who performed the capture.

platform.description: Social media platform captured. Must match a platform id from constants.json.

os.description: Operating system of the capture device.

sequence_number.description: Sequential order of this screenshot within the section (1-based).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the screenshot was captured.

sha256_hash.description: Point-of-capture SHA-256 hex digest of the screenshot file.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the screenshot PNG file.

source_url_or_screen.description: URL visible in the browser at the time of capture, or a screen descriptor for mobile captures.
